title: Tutorial Goblin
body: A small goblin has stolen your attention and is dragging it toward a 47-minute tutorial you will never finish. It grins from behind an open browser tab.
callToAction: Close every tutorial tab except one, then set a timer and watch only the next 90 seconds of it.

title: Reference Oracle
body: An old oracle made entirely of screenshots offers you a look at how the professionals actually solved this shot.
callToAction: Find one real film, game or animation still that matches the mood you are chasing and save it to a reference folder.

title: Glitch Encounter
body: The render flickers, a frame drops, and something in the timeline is quietly wrong. The glitch stares back at you.
callToAction: Scrub your latest export once at full speed and write down the exact timecode of the first thing that looks broken.

title: Insight Shrine
body: A quiet shrine glows in the corner of your workspace. It asks for no offering except one honest sentence.
callToAction: Open your last render and write down one thing you would change if you started it again.

title: Lucky Render
body: Against all odds the render finished early, the cache held, and nothing crashed. The machine spirits are pleased.
callToAction: Save an incremental version of your current project file and name it something you will recognise tomorrow.

title: Keybind Merchant
body: A hooded trader spreads out a cloth of shortcuts and swears each one is worth an hour of your life.
callToAction: Pick one action you did with the mouse today and look up its keyboard shortcut, then use it three times.

title: The Silent Cut
body: A spirit of the edit bay mutes your timeline and asks whether the picture still tells the story on its own.
callToAction: Mute all audio and watch 30 seconds of your edit, then note one cut that stops working without sound.

title: Scope Hydra
body: Every time you finish one idea for this project, two more heads grow back demanding to be animated.
callToAction: Write your project's goal in a single sentence and cross out one feature that does not serve it.
